description.subtitle: Manchester City Puma Soccer Ball in Mini Size - Light Blue
description.intro: The Puma Manchester City Essentials soccer ball is perfect for fans of the citizen club who want to enjoy soccer anywhere. Its mini size makes it ideal for improving control, playing recreational games or completing any soccer collection.
key_benefits: Mini size: Perfect for improving technique and ball control
Official Manchester City design: Colors and crest inspired by the English club
Heavy Duty Construction: Machine stitched panels for durability
Uso recreativo: Ideal para entrenamientos ligeros y ocio
Comfortable touch: Smooth surface for better hitting feeling

source.subtitle: Balón de fútbol Puma del manchester City en talla mini - azul claro

Diseño oficial Manchester City: Colores y escudo inspirados en el club inglés
Construcción resistente: Paneles cosidos a máquina para mayor durabilidad
